description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'BaseVariable' which serves as a base for different variable types within a code generation framework. It includes methods for encoding/decoding in C and Java, getters/setters, and properties related to variable attributes.

classes.name: BaseVariable
classes.description: An abstract class representing a variable with various attributes and methods for code generation and data handling.

methods.name: resolveReferences
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for post-loading dependency resolution.

methods.name: getCtype
methods.description: Returns the C language type representation for the variable.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java language type representation for the variable.

methods.name: getJsonKey
methods.description: Returns the JSON key associated with this variable.

methods.name: getNativeEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code lines to encode this variable.

methods.name: getNativeDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates C code lines to decode this variable.

methods.name: getJavaEncodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code lines to encode this variable.

methods.name: getJavaDecodeLines
methods.description: Generates Java code lines to decode this variable.

methods.name: getJavaIpcObjectType
methods.description: Returns the Java IPC object type for this variable.
